children.text: makes focused tools for designers — type, ideas, mockups, icons, patterns, sound and brand handover. Built by

tools.name: Typeforge
tools.tagline: A font editor that runs in the browser.
tools.lead: Open a typeface, reshape it, export a real font.
tools.description:
Typeforge reads .ttf, .otf, .woff and .woff2 files and writes a valid TrueType or OpenType file back out, with its kerning and spacing intact.

It can also draw a family from nothing. Letters are built from a skeleton swept by a pen, so weight is an input to the drawing rather than a shove applied to a finished outline.

features.title: Glyph view
features.description: Direct outline editing with bezier nodes, handles and a pen tool.

features.title: Kerning
features.description: Click the gap between two letters and drag. Pairs and classes.

features.title: Parameters
features.description: Weight, width, slant, x-height and corner radius across the whole face.

features.title: Build
features.description: Accented letters assembled from their parts, read from Unicode itself.

features.title: Draw
features.description: 452 glyphs across Latin, Greek and Cyrillic, in nine weights.

features.title: Export
features.description: TrueType, OpenType, or one variable font with a weight axis.

tools.runs: In your browser. Fonts are never uploaded.

tools.name: Ideation Board
tools.tagline: A board where you drop ideas and work on them.
tools.lead: Images, video, sound, 3D models, notes and links on one canvas.
tools.description:
Drop anything onto the board and work on it where it lies: put effects on anything with pixels, run a sound through effects of its own, make a depth map of a photograph, or ask for twelve versions of a card and keep the ones worth keeping.

Group cards into sections, draw connections between them, and put a board inside a board when one canvas is no longer enough.

features.title: Drop anything
features.description: Images, video, audio, 3D models, notes, links and files.

features.title: Effects
features.description: GPU effects for pictures and video, and effects of their own for sound.

features.title: Depth maps
features.description: Read the depth of a photograph and push other pictures around with it.

features.title: Twelve versions
features.description: Ask for variations of anything and keep the best.

features.title: Sections
features.description: Group, label and connect cards. Nest boards inside boards.

features.title: Export
features.description: Take any of it out as a full-resolution picture.

tools.runs: In your browser. Boards are kept on your machine, with no account.

tools.name: Mockup Studio
tools.tagline: Photoreal mockups, rendered in your browser.
tools.lead: Drop in a screenshot. Get a studio shot back.
tools.description:
Mockup Studio puts your screenshot on a device’s display, lit by a captured photography studio, or prints it onto merchandise. Drag to turn the device, pick a focal length and a backdrop, and export the frame.

Keyframe the device or the camera and export a short video. The screenshot is never uploaded, and there is no account or API key.

features.title: Devices
features.description: iPhone, MacBook, iMac, Mac Studio and Apple Watch Ultra.

features.title: Merchandise
features.description: T-shirt, tote bag, water bottle, ID card and clipboard.

features.title: Lighting
features.description: Image-based light from real photography studios.

features.title: Animation
features.description: Keyframes, and a turntable preset that loops cleanly.

features.title: Export
features.description: Stills and video, made in the browser.

tools.runs: In your browser, in a window at least 720 px wide.

tools.name: Glyphs
tools.tagline: A parametric icon library and editor.
tools.lead: Thousands of icons, redrawn at once by a few sliders.
tools.description:
Every icon is drawn on a 24 grid with every radius and gap measured in stroke units, so changing the stroke or the corners re-derives the whole library at once.

Four styles, each with rounded or sharp corners. Export one icon, a sprite, an icon font, or a whole category as a ZIP.

features.title: Four styles
features.description: Stroke, two-tone, duotone and fill.

features.title: Corners
features.description: Rounded or sharp, applied across every icon.

features.title: Stroke
features.description: From 1 to 4 on the 24 grid, previewed from 16 to 48 px.

features.title: Library
features.description: 1,366 icons in all eight versions, and a core set of 1,854.

features.title: Export
features.description: SVG, sprite, icon font, JSON and per-category ZIPs.

tools.runs: In your browser. A static site with no server code.

tools.name: Pattern Gen
tools.tagline: Turns a logo into a system of brand patterns.
tools.lead: Patterns measured from the mark, not laid over it.
tools.description:
Pattern Gen reads an SVG mark and works out what makes it recognisable — its colours, its angles, its symmetry, the unit it is drawn on — then builds patterns from those findings rather than from generic decoration.

Every pattern is measured before it is offered, and each one comes with a written report on where it belongs and where it does not.

features.title: Four families
features.description: Shape, gradient, pixel and dimensional. Twenty-five ideas.

features.title: Measured
features.description: Seams, range and survival at small sizes, checked first.

features.title: Reports
features.description: A written case for every pattern, with what was measured.

features.title: Studio
features.description: Tune density and colour, reroll, and watch the loop play.

features.title: Export
features.description: SVG tile, PNG proofs, CSS, a React component and a Lottie loop.

tools.runs: In your browser, or from the command line.

tools.name: Beat Studio
tools.tagline: Sound design for video, in the browser.
tools.lead: It reads your clip and says what belongs on each moment.
tools.description:
Load a clip and Beat Studio finds the moments in it that want a sound, then suggests what belongs on each. Place sounds from a library filed by the moment they serve, and export a file that lines up when you drop it back into your editor.

A second screen takes a recording apart: drop in a beat and it comes back as the drums, the bass, whatever is in front and everything else, each one a layer of its own.

features.title: Reads the picture
features.description: Finds the hits in a clip and suggests sounds for each.

features.title: Library
features.description: Filed by what a sound does on screen, not what made it.

features.title: Stems
features.description: Split a recording into parts, then split those again.

features.title: Synthesised
features.description: Every sound is made with the Web Audio API.

features.title: Export
features.description: WAV, MP3, MIDI and a marker list, at 24 bits and 48k.

tools.runs: In your browser. Clips never leave your machine.

tools.name: Brand Handover
tools.tagline: One approved mark in, a whole brand package out.
tools.lead: Change the mark, and every document changes with it.
tools.description:
Upload the approved mark once and Brand Handover derives everything downstream of it: lockups in every colourway, icons, favicons, social crops, the brand pattern, the guidelines manual, the client deck and the delivery package.

None of the documents holds a copy of the mark, so a late revision costs a rebuild rather than a week of remaking files by hand.

features.title: Reads the mark
features.description: Ink box, clear space and minimum sizes, measured from the file.

features.title: Manual and deck
features.description: Guidelines and a client presentation, built together.

features.title: Files
features.description: SVG, PDF, .ai and PNG for every lockup in every colourway.

features.title: Canvas
features.description: Arrange blocks and place photographs; drawn blocks stay true.

features.title: Delivery
features.description: Around 150 files, packaged as one zip.

tools.runs: Hosted, or on your own machine, where nothing is uploaded.
